content.short: Blockchain Cuties Universe is an NFT collectible game with adventures and dungeons.
content.description: Blockchain Cuties Universe is an NFT collectible game where players can interact with their NFTs in-game, farm items to equip, and trade them on the in-game market for the cryptocurrency of their choice. The game spans multiple blockchains, prioritizes low costs, and lets players pick a preferred chain while still joining the broader cross-chain community. NFTs can be sold, traded, or used for siring, and a single account can attach multiple blockchains to access all features. Play, learn, earn.
